bracket.name: bracket

params.description: Length of the plate that goes against the wall, up the wall.
params.name: wall_length_mm

params.description: Length of the plate that sticks out, carrying the load.
params.name: shelf_length_mm

params.description: How wide the bracket is.
params.name: width_mm

params.description: Plate thickness. 6 mm in PETG carries a shelf; below 4 it flexes and the fixings pull through.
params.name: thickness_mm

params.description: Fillet on the inside corner. Leave unset for 1.5 x thickness, which is where the stress raiser stops mattering.
params.name: corner_r_mm

params.description: A triangular web across the corner. It carries the bending moment into the wall plate instead of the corner, and it is why a printed bracket holds.
params.name: gusset

params.description: Gusset thickness. Leave unset to match the plates.
params.name: gusset_thickness_mm

params.description: How far along each plate the gusset reaches, as a fraction.
params.name: gusset_fraction

params.description: Fixing holes in the wall plate.
params.name: wall_holes

params.description: Fixing holes in the shelf plate.
params.name: shelf_holes

params.description: Fixing hole diameter. 5.5 clears an M5; 4.5 an M4.
params.name: hole_dia_mm

params.description: Counterbore depth for a screw head to sit flush. 0 for none. The bore is on the OUTSIDE face, so it prints as a plain step.
params.name: counterbore_mm

params.description: Distance from a hole centre to the plate edge. Leave unset for 1.4 x the hole diameter, below which the material tears out.
params.name: edge_margin_mm

print_notes: Orientation: standing on the back edge of the wall plate. DO NOT ROTATE - printed flat this is about a third as strong.
No supports needed in that orientation.
PETG or ABS. PLA creeps under a sustained load and the shelf droops.
4 walls and 40% infill. On a bracket the walls carry the load, so wall count matters far more than infill density.
Layer 0.2 mm. Finer does not make it stronger.
bracket.summary: An L of two plates with a gusset across the corner and fixing holes. Prints standing on its back edge so the layers run across the load.

enclosure.name: enclosure

params.description: X, outside width.
params.name: width_mm

params.description: Y, outside depth.
params.name: depth_mm

params.description: Z, outside height of the box, not counting the roof.
params.name: height_mm

params.description: Wall thickness. 3 mm is sound for a birdhouse in PETG.
params.name: wall_mm

params.description: Floor thickness. Leave unset to match the wall.
params.name: floor_mm

params.description: Vertical corner radius on the outside.
params.name: corner_r_mm

params.description: Entrance hole diameter. 32 mm suits a starling, 28 a great tit, 25 a blue tit. Set 0 for no entrance - a plain box.
params.name: entrance_dia_mm

params.description: Height of the entrance centre above the floor. Leave unset to put it in the upper third, which keeps chicks away from a reaching cat.
params.name: entrance_height_mm

params.description: Which wall the entrance goes in: front, back, left or right.
params.name: entrance_face

params.description: A raised collar around the entrance, thickening the wall so a cat or a squirrel cannot reach through to the nest. 18 to 25 mm is usual. 0 for none.
params.name: predator_guard_mm

params.description: Extend the back wall this far above and below the box, giving a flat plate to screw to a tree or a post. 0 for none.
params.name: back_plate_mm

params.description: Include a roof. Printed as a separate piece.
params.name: roof

params.description: How far the roof stands proud on every side, to shed rain clear of the entrance.
params.name: roof_overhang_mm

params.description: Roof slab thickness.
params.name: roof_thick_mm

params.description: Roof slope. Printed FLAT and set on at an angle, so the slope costs no support. 0 gives a flat roof.
params.name: roof_pitch_deg

params.description: Roof shape. 'gable' is the triangular two-sided roof people picture when they say birdhouse: two panels meeting at a ridge along the width. 'mono' is a single panel leaning one way. 'flat' is a lid. All three print flat and are set on afterwards, so none of them costs support.
params.name: roof_style

params.description: Depth of the lip under the roof that drops into the cavity and locates the lid. For FLAT lids. A lip cannot enter a rectangular hole while the lid is tilted, so a pitched roof wants 0 and glue.
params.name: roof_lip_mm

params.description: Gap between the lip and the box, so the roof lifts off.
params.name: roof_clearance_mm

params.description: Exterior relief. plain is flat. board cuts horizontal shiplap grooves for a weatherboard look. slat cuts vertical reveals for a modern slatted panel look.
params.name: finish

params.description: Spacing between grooves, centre to centre.
params.name: finish_pitch_mm

params.description: Width of each groove. Must be at least two nozzle widths to resolve.
params.name: finish_groove_mm

params.description: How deep the grooves cut into the wall.
params.name: finish_depth_mm

params.description: Drainage holes in the floor. A birdhouse without them rots.
params.name: drain_holes

params.description: Drainage hole diameter.
params.name: drain_dia_mm

params.description: Ventilation slots near the top of each side wall.
params.name: vent_slots

params.description: Two screw holes through the back wall for mounting.
params.name: mount_holes

params.description: Mounting hole diameter.
params.name: mount_dia_mm

print_notes: Two pieces: the box upright, the roof flat beside it. Do not rotate.
No supports. The cavity opens upward and the entrance is a horizontal bore.
Layer height 0.2 to 0.28 mm. This is a big part and detail is not the point.
PETG or ASA outdoors. PLA goes brittle in UV within a season.
3 walls and 15% infill is plenty - the walls carry it, not the infill.
Glue the roof on at the stated pitch, or leave it loose to clean the box out.
No perch, deliberately: nest-box birds do not need one and it gives a predator somewhere to stand.
enclosure.summary: RECTANGULAR. For anything round use `vessel`. A hollow box: walls, a floor, an optional opening in one wall, an optional lift-off roof or lid, drainage, ventilation, a predator guard and a mounting plate. Everything optional is off by setting it to zero, so a plain open-topped box is this template with the extras turned off.

keyring_device.name: keyring_device

params.description: Overall body width across the trim caps. At 30 mm the glass side bezel lands on exactly one extrusion width; below 26 mm drop the screen detail entirely.
params.name: body_width_mm

params.description: Single constant thickness of the whole part.
params.name: depth_mm

params.description: Thinnest handle section that survives a keychain. Below 2.4 it snaps.
params.name: min_handle_mm

params.description: Thinnest engraved or embossed line worth cutting.
params.name: min_stroke_mm

params.description: How far the boss must reach past the handle on each side.
params.name: boss_margin_mm

params.description: Module pocket depth, i.e. the bezel step. Deliberately deeper than true scale: a scale-correct 0.44 mm recess is geometrically right and visually dead, with too little depth to catch a shadow.
params.name: recess_mm

params.description: Additional depth of the glass area inside the bezel.
params.name: glass_mm

params.description: Camera dot depth.
params.name: cam_mm

params.description: Attempted and reverted if OCC produces an invalid solid, which it does on this silhouette. Set to 0 to stop trying. For elephant foot use your slicer's first-layer compensation instead - that is the correct fix and costs no geometry.
params.name: front_chamfer_mm

params.description: As above, back face.
params.name: back_chamfer_mm

params.description: Engrave the traced wordmark. OFF by default because it requires logo_json, a file path that has to come from somewhere - a measured baseline showed this default costing an attempt on every keyring request that did not mention the logo. Set it true and point logo_json at the output of `whittle measure trace`.
params.name: logo_on

params.description: Path to traced logo outlines from `whittle measure trace`. Relative paths resolve against the spec file. Required when logo_on.
params.name: logo_json

params.description: Logo width as a fraction of the fabric waist width.
params.name: logo_width_fraction

params.description: Engraving depth.
params.name: logo_depth_mm

params.description: Grow the logo until its thinnest stroke is printable.
params.name: logo_autoscale

params.description: Engrave the screen UI as raised cards.
params.name: ui_on

params.description: How far the cards stand above the glass floor.
params.name: ui_raise_mm

params.description: Shrink every element slightly to keep the gaps printable.
params.name: ui_shrink_mm

print_notes: Orientation: flat, back face on the bed. DO NOT ROTATE.
Layer height 0.12 mm - the face detail is in Z, that is the whole point.
PETG. A PLA keyring at this section will snap at the handle.
4 walls, 100% infill. It is 6.5 cm3; solid costs nothing and a hollow keyring crushes.
No supports. Ironing on the top surface only, if your slicer has it.
Elephant foot: first-layer compensation 0.15 mm.
keyring_device.summary: One-piece keyring: constant-depth extrusion, fused handle, engraved face detail.

louvre_vent.name: louvre_vent

params.description: X, outside width of the body.
params.name: frame_w_mm

params.description: Y, body depth, the insertion direction.
params.name: frame_d_mm

params.description: Z, outside height and print height.
params.name: frame_h_mm

params.description: Rail thickness top and bottom.
params.name: wall_mm

params.description: Vertical corner radius on the body.
params.name: bezel_r_mm

params.description: Flange thickness in Y.
params.name: flange_t_mm

params.description: How far the flange stands proud, all round.
params.name: flange_over_mm

params.description: Screw clearance hole. 3.4 is M3 clearance.
params.name: screw_dia_mm

params.description: Advisory: cut your hole this much over body size.
params.name: body_clear_mm

params.description: Number of louvre blades. Leave unset to derive from the aperture width, keeping roughly the reference 17 mm pitch and never exceeding what the crank linkage can fit.
params.name: n_blades

params.description: Blade depth in Y when straight through. Leave unset to derive as 0.82 of the blade pitch, so the blades clear each other as they swing whatever the frame width.
params.name: blade_chord_mm

params.description: Blade thickness in X.
params.name: blade_thick_mm

params.description: As printed. 0 = straight through.
params.name: blade_angle_deg

params.description: Mechanism travel limit. Past ~40 the bar fouls the pivot pins.
params.name: max_angle_deg

params.description: Rounding on the blade edges.
params.name: blade_tip_r_mm

params.description: Pivot pin diameter. Below 2.4 it snaps.
params.name: pin_dia_mm

params.description: Radial clearance, pin to socket.
params.name: pin_clear_r_mm

params.description: How far a pin sits inside its socket.
params.name: pin_engage_mm

params.description: Vertical air gap at every shoulder. Bridged by the layer above.
params.name: pin_gap_z_mm

params.description: Socket depth beyond the engagement.
params.name: socket_extra_mm

params.description: Material around a pivot socket.
params.name: hub_wall_mm

params.description: Crank arm length, pivot to crank pin. Leave unset to derive from the chord, which keeps the crank hub inside the blade.
params.name: crank_r_mm

params.description: Crank pin diameter.
params.name: crank_pin_dia_mm

params.description: Crank pin engagement depth.
params.name: crank_engage_mm

params.description: Material around a crank socket.
params.name: crank_hub_wall_mm

params.description: Tie bar thickness in Z.
params.name: bar_thick_mm

params.description: Tie bar width in Y.
params.name: bar_width_mm

params.description: Material beyond the outermost crank pin.
params.name: bar_tail_mm

params.description: Which blade carries the thumb tab, as an index. Leave unset to use the most central blade, which gives the tab the most room to sweep before it reaches the edge of the aperture.
params.name: grip_blade

params.description: Pivot to tab tip. Leave unset to derive from the frame depth. It must stay proud of the flange at max_angle_deg, not merely at rest, so a deeper frame needs a longer tab.
params.name: grip_len_mm

params.description: Tab thickness in X, a little fatter than the blade.
params.name: grip_w_mm

params.description: Thumb paddle width in X.
params.name: grip_pad_w_mm

params.description: Thumb paddle depth in Y.
params.name: grip_pad_d_mm

print_notes: Orientation: as modelled, flange edge-on, frame flat on the bed.
Layer height 0.20 mm.
PETG or ABS. PLA creeps and the blades go slack.
No supports. Every print-in-place gap is bridged by the layer above it.
After printing, work the knob back and forth a few times to free the pins.
Cut your mounting hole body_clear_mm over the body size.
louvre_vent.summary: Print-in-place adjustable louvre vent with a parallel-crank linkage.

vessel.name: vessel

params.description: Diameter at the widest point of the body.
params.name: outer_dia_mm

params.description: Overall height including the foot.
params.name: height_mm

params.description: Wall thickness.
params.name: wall_mm

params.description: Thickness of the base. Defaults to a little over the wall.
params.name: floor_mm

params.description: straight is a plain cone. flared opens out towards the rim like a bowl. belly bulges in the middle and draws back in like a vase. cylinder is a straight-sided pot. custom takes the silhouette from profile_points, which is how a shape MEASURED off a mesh becomes an editable part.
params.name: profile

params.description: The silhouette as (radius_mm, height_mm) pairs from the base up. Only used when profile is custom. This is what a generated mesh turns into: measured off the surface, then editable like any other number.
params.name: profile_points

params.description: Diameter at the rim. Derived from the profile if left out.
params.name: rim_dia_mm

params.description: Diameter where it meets the foot. Derived if left out.
params.name: base_dia_mm

params.description: Height of a narrower foot ring under the body. 0 for none.
params.name: foot_mm

params.description: Foot diameter. Derived if left out.
params.name: foot_dia_mm

params.description: Rounding on the rim edge, so it is not a knife edge.
params.name: rim_round_mm

params.description: Holes through the base. A plant pot needs them, a bowl does not.
params.name: drain_holes

params.description: Diameter of each drainage hole.
params.name: drain_dia_mm

params.description: solid is a plain wall. cells cuts a Voronoi web through it, leaving a strut between every pair of holes.
params.name: pattern

params.description: How many cells around and up the wall. More means finer.
params.name: cell_count

params.description: Width of the web between two holes. This is the part that carries the load.
params.name: strut_mm

params.description: Which arrangement of cells. Change it for a different pattern of the same character. The same seed always gives the same bowl.
params.name: cell_seed

params.description: Solid band left under the rim. The rim is what holds the whole thing round.
params.name: rim_band_mm

params.description: Solid band left above the floor, so the base is not perforated.
params.name: base_band_mm

print_notes: Orientation: standing upright, exactly as modelled. The cavity opens upward, so there is nothing to support.
No supports. If the profile needed them the spec would have been refused - the wall lean is checked against 45 degrees.
Vase mode / spiralised outer contour suits this well if the wall is a single extrusion wide and there are no drainage holes.
PETG for anything that holds water. PLA is fine dry and will soften in a hot car or a dishwasher.
3 walls minimum. On a thin turned wall the walls ARE the part.
vessel.summary: A ROUND vessel turned about its axis - bowl, dish, plant pot, cup or vase. Open at the top, with a real wall, a floor and an optional foot. Use this whenever the thing is round. The enclosure template is rectangular and will make a square box out of a bowl.
